title: Residual heartbeat volatility does not establish robust incremental age prediction across two public collections
abstract: Absolute adjacent AR(2) heartbeat-innovation correlation reduced age-group transfer logloss by 0.069623 from Fantasia to NSR2 and 0.007273 in reverse, beyond conventional HRV and linear serial dependence. Source-plus-target bootstrap 95% intervals included zero ([-0.108810,0.287552] and [-0.146262,0.133273]); reverse-transfer AUC declined. This exploratory separate-collection analysis does not establish a robust incremental aging biomarker or verified participant-disjoint confirmation.
